assumptions: One dynamics specification and current joint state per path; calendar-time latent transitions and independent match tempo shocks continue through fixtures. Simulated scores do not update the sampled latent states.

Captured full-time results are fixed, including today; fitting excludes today. Fixture dates follow the captured schedule; fixed-state models can use cutoff-date placeholders for unscheduled fixtures.
Nondecisive shared positions split mass across occupied ranks for reporting.
EFL disciplinary tiebreak data are unavailable. Remaining ties split rank mass equally; this is an uncertainty assumption, not an application of disciplinary rules.
Points adjustments include only supplied sanctions known at the cutoff.
Playoff promotion simulates the applicable bracket conditional on every regular-season path using the structural match model.

playoff_model.final_site: neutral via an equal mixture of virtual home designations
playoff_model.match_model: structural score distribution at synthetic postseason dates
playoff_model.regular_season_conditioning: one simulated bracket per final-table path
playoff_model.semi_final_home_order: higher regular-season seed at home in the second leg
playoff_model.tied_knockout_scores: equal advancement chance after modeled regulation scores

semi_finals: 3 plays lowest-ranked quarter-final winner over two legs
4 plays highest-ranked quarter-final winner over two legs

ranking_rules_evidence.limitations: Disciplinary penalty points at the 42-match cutoff, successful wrongful-dismissal claims, and twelve-point sending-off counts are not currently available to season simulation. Unresolved rank mass is an explicit model assumption, not an official disciplinary or deciding-match outcome. The reviewed text does not specify neutral-site scoring, extra-time or penalty probabilities, or Championship semi-final leg order; the simulator exposes its approximations. Edition verification applies only to the named season.
